info.name: 00-FixtureStripeRide
info.description: Smoke fixture: one real Stripe card ride end-to-end (fresh driver onboarding + Stripe Connect, fresh rider + card, search/select/accept/start/end, ride invoices) with API-only guards: booking COMPLETED with a captured card charge (cardInfo), BPP ride commission > 0 (driver ride financeData), RIDE_FARE component cap > 0 (rider fareBreakup). No refund actions. 01-03 each build their own ride with these same steps, so this collection is standalone.

item.name: Verify Booking COMPLETED + card charge captured (rider booking list)

exec: function _get(n){ pm.sendRequest({ url:_u("{{baseUrl_app}}/rideBooking/list?limit=1&onlyActive=false&offset=0"), method:'GET', header:{'token': pm.environment.get('rider_token')} }, function(err,res){ var d={}; try{ d=res.json(); }catch(e){} if(_ok(d)||n<=0){ _done(d, res ? res.code : 0); } else { setTimeout(function(){ _get(n-1); }, 3000); } }); }
function _ok(d){ var b=_b(d); return !!(b && b.status==='COMPLETED' && b.cardInfo && b.rideList && b.rideList.length); }
pm.test('booking COMPLETED', function(){ pm.expect(b, 'no booking for the fresh rider').to.exist; pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });
pm.test('card charge captured (cardInfo comes from the CHARGED payment transaction)', function(){ pm.expect(b && b.cardInfo, 'no CHARGED transaction after polling').to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('BAP rideId captured and distinct from the booking id', function(){ pm.expect(ride && ride.id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(ride.id).to.not.eql(b.id); });
pm.test('no refunds on a fresh ride', function(){ pm.expect((b && b.refunds) || []).to.have.length(0); });
console.log('Booking', b && b.id, 'status', b && b.status, 'rideId', ride && ride.id, 'card', JSON.stringify(b && b.cardInfo));
